Still catching her breath, Smart Falcon 
called out to the audience from the stage. 
However, the audience's response was faint 
and sparse.

Even so, she didn't lose heart. 
Desperately calling out to the audience, 
"Let's sing together!", she delivered her 
song once more.

Eventually, other Umamusume began humming 
along to the song. People started paying 
attention to her earnest dedication. 
Little by little, something was beginning 
to change.
